goal: Give the Author Lane Abandonment Audit's two required-check authority reads the elevated read token they need: pass AUTHORITY_TOKEN (secrets.SYNC_TOKEN, the guarded-merge pattern) in the audit step env, and scope only those two reads to it via a token-scoped helper (scripts/lib/authority-token-read.mjs). Without the token the reads fail closed exactly as before. Proof card for the end-to-end criterion: #3541.
prohibited_actions: Do not touch any migration, database object, live row, or branch-protection setting.
Do not use AUTHORITY_TOKEN for anything except the two authority reads; every other GitHub call stays on the ambient token.
Do not weaken the fail-closed rule: with no elevated token the audit must still refuse rather than report zero.
assumptions: Disclosed: generation 1 is published before any reviewer is drawn; no prior refs/db-contracts/3857/1 exists.
secrets.SYNC_TOKEN exists and is the same classic PAT guarded-migration-merge.yml already passes as AUTHORITY_TOKEN.
stop_conditions: Stop on any gate refusal rather than weakening the gate.
Stop if the change needs a file outside allowed_paths.
